sentence: This project builds quantitative methods to target and guide epilepsy surgery.
This project studies how stem-like T cells infiltrate the kidney and differentiate into cells that drive tissue destruction in lupus nephritis.
This project builds cell carriers that decrease the use of expensive reagents and help stem cells culture more scalably.
This project studies how lung adenocarcinoma tumors acquire and utilize cysteine and which transporters are responsible for uptake.
This project tests whether neuropeptide Y circuits in the medial prefrontal cortex modulate binge-like ethanol drinking in mice.
This project provides transcriptome and genome sequencing and analysis to study how host and pathogen interact in mucormycosis infections.
This project tests whether depleting adenosine in tumors helps immunotherapy and chemotherapy work against lung cancer.
This project studies how maternal immune activation changes glycosaminoglycan sulfation patterns in offspring during neurodevelopment.
This project tries to find out how biallelic variants cause myelin deficits.
This project builds algorithms that use electronic health record data to detect bleeding and target lesion revascularization after stent procedures.
This project builds tools to study mutations in tissues and how cells change when they harbor those variants.
This project tests whether ionizing radiation makes breast cancer cells and tumors more responsive to an antibody drug conjugate.
This project studies how the metabolic state of hair follicle stem cells controls quiescence and their ability to initiate tumorigenesis.
This project follows children with chronic kidney disease into adulthood to find out how risk factors affect long-term health outcomes.
This project creates a transgenic mouse platform strain that expresses Cas9, so CRISPR methods can make mice for studying T cell responses.
This project uses sequencing to find out how alloreactive T cells change over time and whether they can be tracked in patients.
This project tests genetically engineered cells in pet dogs with osteosarcoma to see how well they act against solid tumors.
This project studies the disease pathways that promote skin and joint inflammation in psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis using molecular signatures.
This project builds silica nanocapsules that cross the blood-brain barrier to deliver CRISPR genome editors to the brain for treating Alzheimer's disease.
This project provides imaging tools to study how drugs of abuse change molecules, cells and brain circuits in substance use disorders.
